risks.title: No retry logic detected
risks.description: LLM API calls can fail due to rate limits, network issues, or service outages. Without retry logic, your application may fail unexpectedly.
risks.recommendation: Add exponential backoff retry logic using tenacity, backoff, or built-in SDK retry options.

risks.title: No fallback mechanism detected
risks.description: If your primary LLM provider goes down, your entire application fails. No fallback provider or model detected.
risks.recommendation: Implement provider fallback (e.g., OpenAI → Anthropic → local model) or use a gateway like LiteLLM.

risks.title: No caching detected
risks.description: Repeated identical prompts result in unnecessary API costs and increased latency. No caching layer detected.
risks.recommendation: Implement semantic caching (GPTCache, Redis) or use provider prompt caching (Anthropic, OpenAI).

risks.title: No guardrails or input validation detected
risks.description: Without input/output validation, your application is vulnerable to prompt injection, PII leakage, and harmful content.
risks.recommendation: Add guardrails using NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI, or custom validation logic.

risks.title: No intelligent routing detected
risks.description: Using the same model for all requests misses optimization opportunities. Simple queries could use cheaper models.
risks.recommendation: Implement task-based routing: use smaller models for simple tasks, larger models for complex reasoning.
